about.heading: about moof
about.body: moof is a specialty matcha and hojicha bar built around hand-whisked ceremonial-grade drinks, soft textures, and exclusive japanese matcha ingredients. the menu keeps things simple: strong tea, fresh milk or oat milk, seasonal flavors, and daily small-batch bakes for takeaway.
about.storeNote: fresh milk / oat milk. hot / cold options available on selected drinks.
